name: abcdeploy
description: A local-first deployment tool that helps beginners run a local folder or repository on their computer or a Linux server.

scripts.check: pnpm check:project && pnpm check:secrets && cargo fmt --all -- --check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm site:build
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter @abcdeploy/desktop test && node --test scripts/build-release-manifest.test.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:mac: CI=true APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY=- pnpm --filter @abcdeploy/desktop tauri build --bundles app,dmg --ci
